_comment: A team's LAST unit routs, without instantly losing. Stages team 0's ONLY unit -- a full-strength (120) but jittery (morale 15) player infantry -- meeting a single enemy infantry head-on. Both blocks are pinned to Tight (formation 1) so packed files still produce the rout inside this clip -- default Normal 2x thins contact enough that onset misses the budget. Sustained frontal casualties erode its morale to 0 (the discipline-scaled rout retune, #529, made this actually reachable -- it used to sit near-immune to routing and simply grind to a stalemate), and it breaks and flees up (faded) while barely bloodied. It used to trigger instant defeat + a paused freeze the moment its last fightable unit left the line; now the battle stays live while it's routing. Routing units are still valid combat targets, and the enemy follows it as it flees -- state-dump verified: FIGHTING at tick 1150, ROUTING by tick 1170 with 91 of its 120 men, and still ROUTING at tick 1300, the clip's end, about 73 wu from where it broke, at (722.5, 405.7) with its pursuer (uid 1) MOVING after it. This clip only needs to show the rout starting and the battle staying live through it, not the whole grind. No player input needed.
